description: External alterations, repairs and works of refurbishment, including installation of replacement windows and doors, removal of plexiglass screen to install a glazed lantern over the lightwell, installation of a new rear dormer, addition of new conservation rooflights, removal of existing hipped roof to create a new rear roof terrace, and replacement of the plastic waste pipes, guttering and vents with painted cast iron, repointing to rear fa�ade and other works.
decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted must be begun not later than the end of three years from the date of this permission.

Reason: In order to comply with the provisions of Section 91 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 (as amended).

Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans:

Location plan; Planning cover letter ref. 03052 dated 03 August 2026 prepared by Turley; Heritage Statement ref. 03052_HTAL dated July 2026 prepared by Turley; Design and Access Statement ref. DAS-1 Rev. P1 dated 13 July 2026 prepared by Ben Pentreath; A-50 Rev.P1; A-99 Rev.P1; A-100 Rev.P1; A110 Rev.P1; A-120 Rev.P1; A-130 Rev.P1; A-200 Rev.P1; A-201 Rev.P1; A-250 Rev.P1; A-500 Rev.P1; A-501.1 Rev.P1; A-501 Rev.P1; A-502.1 Rev.P1; A-502 Rev.P1; A-650.1 Rev.P1; A-650 Rev.P1; A-651.1 Rev.P1; A-651 Rev.P1; A-652.1 Rev.P1; A-652 Rev.P1; A-653.1 Rev.P1; A-653 Rev.P1; A-654.1 Rev.P1; A-654.2 Rev.P1; A-654.3 Rev.P1; A-654 Rev.P1; S-50 Rev.P1; S-99 Rev.P1; S-100 Rev.P1; S-110 Rev.P1; S-120 Rev.P1; S-130 Rev.P1; S-140 Rev.P1; S-200 Rev.P1; S-210 Rev.P1; S-250 Rev.P1; A-211 Rev.P1; S-220 Rev.P1; A-220 Rev.P2; A-140 Rev.P2; A-210 Rev.P2.

Reason: For the avoidance of doubt and in the interest of proper planning.
Condition : 3 - All new external work shall be carried out in materials that resemble, as closely as possible, in colour and texture those of the existing building, unless otherwise specified in the approved application. 

Reason: To safeguard the appearance of the premises and the character of the immediate area in accordance with the requirements of policies D1 and D2 of the London Borough of Camden Local Plan 2017. 
Condition : 4 - The use of the roof as a terrace shall not commence until the screen, as shown on the approved drawings (drawing reference numbers A-220 Rev.P2; A-140 Rev.P2; A-210 Rev.P2), has been constructed. The screen shall be permanently retained thereafter.    

Reason: In order to prevent unreasonable overlooking of neighbouring premises in accordance with the requirements of policies A1, D1 and D2 of the London Borough of Camden Local Plan 2017.
